Hi David,

We're kicking off Atlas Payments' vendor assessment for Q3. Two asks to start: (1) Can you share your latest SOC 2 Type II report (covering at least the last 12 months) or confirm audit window dates? Quick background: our procurement team needs confirmation of audit period and whether the report covers production in us-west-2.

Thanks — can you respond with a plan and ETA by EOD PST?
